name: Saturday Mix
description: One from each lane, made from what is home after the party: no mint, no Baileys. Fresh citrus, juices and cream required.

drinks.note: Havana Club Especial; Kraken if you want it darker.
Havana Club 3 and fresh grapefruit. Shake hard.
Russell's 10 or Angel's Envy over a big cube.
Taste the sweet vermouth first; if it is flat or sour, skip this one.
Only if the prosecco is unopened.
